messages:
Maya: quick thread: we need a minimal DP intake for design partners that fits into a 15m screening call. target: onboard in 3 weeks, 8-week eval.
Leo: agree. keep questions binary where possible to speed screening.
Ravi: propose: Region / Private deploy? / DPA ok? / Weekly sync? / Eng lead hours/week / Primary workload (chat/embed/rerank) / Success metric (one-line).
Ivy: also capture timezone overlap hours and any maintenance blackout dates.
Maya: add a 'rollback trigger' line so partners tell us what they’d find unacceptable. keeps expectations clear.
Ravi: scoring idea: 0-3 per bucket: Eligibility (security/compliance), Commitment, Fit. weight Eligibility x2. threshold >=7/10 to proceed.
Leo: compliance check: @compliance-bot do we need region-specific DPAs?
compliance-bot: (automated) Standard DPA + SCCs acceptable for EU transfers. Flag for manual review if customer requires on-prem only.
Ivy: timeline: outreach wk0-2, screen + intake wk2, onboarding wk3, eval wk4-11, wrap wk12.
Maya: ok i'll draft the short intake form and a 3-question micro-survey to send at wk2/6/10.
Ravi: add an automated acceptance test in onboarding (prompt set + perf checks) to surface regressions early.
Maya: thanks — i'll post the draft to the dp intake doc EOD for comments.
